description: Free checklist for a pre-seed or seed raise: answer ten yes/no questions (company set up, founders full time, clean cap table, IP, demand, metrics, plan, deck, documents) and get a readiness score with the exact gaps to close first. Nothing is stored.

clean_cap_table.description: The cap table is clean (no large stake held by someone who left)

data_room.description: The basic documents are in one folder

deck_ready.description: A short deck or memo is ready

demand_evidence.description: You have evidence of demand (users, pilots, letters of intent or revenue)

founders_full_time.description: All founders work full time on it

ip_assigned.description: Code and IP belong to the company

metrics_tracked.description: You track a few metrics every month

one_liner.description: You can say what you do in one sentence a stranger understands

use_of_funds.description: You know what the money buys and which milestone it reaches

name: fundraising_readiness
title: Fundraising readiness check
